about.label: Who we are
about.vision: To be a leading technology company in custom digital solutions, recognized for our quality, commitment and ability to turn ideas into scalable, high-impact systems.
about.mission: To create custom software that transforms the way companies operate, combining innovation, strategy and top-tier technology.

team.label: The team
team.desc: A compact team with total focus. No middlemen — you work directly with the people building your product.

services.label: Services
services.desc: From idea to product in production. We design, build and maintain software tailored to the way your business works.

items.title: Web Development
items.text: Fast, accessible, SEO-optimized websites, landing pages and web apps, ready to grow with your brand.

items.title: Custom Systems
items.text: Admin dashboards, order management, inventory and internal processes with per-user roles and permissions.

items.title: APIs & Backend
items.text: Secure, scalable APIs with clean architecture, JWT authentication, relational databases and real-time features.

items.title: Automation & AI
items.text: WhatsApp conversational assistants, automated workflows and AI integrations working 24/7 for your business.

items.title: Modernization
items.text: We migrate legacy systems to modern technologies module by module, without stopping operations or breaking what already works.

items.title: Mobile Apps & Cloud
items.text: PWAs and mobile apps connected to your system, with automated deployments and separate staging and production environments.

projects.label: Work
projects.desc: Real products, in production, solving concrete problems for businesses and institutions.

botbite.tagline: An AI-powered virtual waiter on WhatsApp.
botbite.description: An assistant that serves restaurant customers right on WhatsApp: it shows the menu, takes orders in several languages and sends them to the register in real time.
features: Multilingual WhatsApp bot with conversational AI
Web dashboard for restaurants, branches, menus and products
Real-time order notifications to the register

magnolias.tagline: End-to-end order management for a bakery with multiple branches.
magnolias.description: Public landing page, online store and admin dashboard covering the whole flow: from taking a custom cake order to the driver delivering it.
features: Orders with multi-tier cakes, flavors and suggested pricing
Drag & drop production board for bakers
Per-branch delivery and role-based views (admin, baker, driver)
Encrypted sensitive data and an interactive user manual

diocesis.name: Diocese of Cd. Obregón
diocesis.tagline: A public and ecclesiastical management platform, modernized from the ground up.
diocesis.description: Public website with news and a directory of priests and parishes, plus an admin dashboard. We migrated the legacy Django backend to NestJS module by module, with zero downtime.
features: News, priest and parish directory, documents
Biblical Institute and ISMA modules with a calendar
Per-module permissions and secure password migration

sergio.bio: Specialized in building scalable web applications with Angular, Vue, NestJS and TypeScript. Passionate about clean architecture, user experience and automation.
about: I'm a Full Stack Developer with more than 5 years of experience building scalable web applications. I focus on efficient, maintainable, user-centered solutions.
I specialize in modern architectures with Angular, Vue, NestJS and TypeScript, applying Clean Architecture and automating processes to guarantee quality code.
Co-founder of DevCrafters, where we help companies build web, mobile and cloud solutions that transform their business processes.

points: Resolved accessibility issues in component libraries.
Improved component adoption through clear documentation.
Designed the database schema for the permissions system.
REST API integration and reactive forms.

monica.bio: Combines frontend development with strategic product thinking. Specialized in UX, information architecture and user-centered digital experience design.

I specialize in Vue.js, Tailwind and Figma, working closely with teams to align design, usability and business goals.
